owner: existing skeleton.app installer and canonical local deployment owner
network: Explicit operator-only acquisition from two fixed HTTPS public artifact URLs: revision-pinned Qwen3-0.6B-Q8_0 Apache-2.0 weights and release-pinned llama.cpp b11429 Ubuntu x64 MIT runtime. Existing proxy and CA environment remain in effect. No credentials, arbitrary URLs, model invocation, service startup or browser download authority.
integrity: Exact expected bytes and SHA256 precede use. Archive extraction materializes only bounded regular libraries, completion executable and license, resolving only archive-internal aliases without creating symlinks. A portable relative-path manifest is admitted by the existing canonical loader before create-only publication. Failed provisioning remains explicitly incomplete and is never activated.
storage: Operator-owned model artifact directory only, not application state or a new store. Existing complete directories are verified and reused, never overwritten. Receipt binds all runtime files, model, license/source identity and deployment manifest.
activation: Operator sets existing AI_PROVIDER=local, clears AI_LOCAL_MODEL_PATH and sets AI_LOCAL_DEPLOYMENT_PATH to the read-only mounted deployment.json, then restarts the existing engine. No inferred promotion or credentials.
limitations: Bundled acquisition recipe is Linux x86_64 CPU only; other architectures use their compatible operator-provisioned runtime.
Small CPU model provides a reproducible integration path, not guaranteed planning quality or trained studio mastery.
Shared-library receipt pins acquisition content; canonical runtime currently independently pins the executable and model.
Download cleanup failure never produces successful activation; abandoned or partial directories retain incomplete marker. Parent private directories are never made public.

transfer_isolation.owner: same existing operator installer; no service/store/scheduler/provider
transfer_isolation.network_worker: fixed stdlib Python -I -S child, exact pinned URL and byte count, only inherited deployment proxy/CA variables; absolute supervisor deadline, terminate/kill/wait before acknowledgement
transfer_isolation.local_copy: No-follow nonblocking regular-file descriptor, exact expected byte ceiling and hash during copy, stable descriptor identity before/after; no unbounded copyfileobj
transfer_isolation.reuse: Existing exact target runtime and configured manifest profile/thread count must match request; no overwrite or implicit reconfiguration

target: Explicit --target linux-x86_64-glibc only. Other host platforms require --prepare-for-container acknowledgement; host/target compatibility reported separately. Artifact preparation does not establish native execution compatibility.
prompt_profile: Explicit Qwen3 nonthinking completion template from canonical QWEN3_COMPLETION_CHAT_TEMPLATE, passed as --chat-template after fixed completion flags. --reasoning off controls display only; template has closed empty think prefix. Exact args/template enter manifest/profile digest. Existing older profile directories are never rewritten and conflict with this recipe.

empty_directory_claim.accepted: New destination, or an existing empty nonsymlink directory owned by the effective operator UID with no group/world write access. Parent symlinks and foreign ownership are rejected.
empty_directory_claim.claim: Exclusive create-only .incomplete marker, fsynced before artifact writes; concurrent or incomplete claims are never overwritten. Check emptiness again after claim.
empty_directory_claim.complete_reuse: Nonempty destinations require the full previously admitted complete receipt/profile; they are never treated as empty or overwritten.
empty_directory_claim.compose: Installer creates host-owned default artifact directory mode0755 before Compose bind mount; a Docker-created foreign root-owned directory is not adopted by another operator.
empty_directory_claim.permissions: Only the explicitly selected artifact directory is made0755; no parent permission changes.

context_profiles.operator_selection: Explicit --context-size; the canonical activation and capacity owners still decide whether work fits.
context_profiles.existing_installation: Requested context must match the issued deployment. Reconfiguration requires a fresh destination; existing files are never overwritten.
context_profiles.original_studio_guidance: 12288 tokens were used for the bounded eight-call original creation workflow; this does not guarantee success or capacity on every host.
